checks.name: The frozen default remains a two-phase 5:5 physiological guide without holds

Standard box: all phase boundaries, labels and current-step indicators follow the actual browser clock

The box marker follows its sides while the circle stays fixed during a hold
Pausing during a hold gives a neutral cue; restart begins a fresh inhale
Switching away from holds selects 4:4, stops, and requires a fresh Start

Invalid pattern and pace selections fail closed and can recover through a valid choice

Hiding a paused guide stops it; becoming visible does not resume it
Page exit and a persisted page return leave an active guide stopped
A delayed animation frame stops instead of jumping into a missed hold
Actual scrolling away from the visual guide stops it and returning does not restart it
A manual still guide keeps text cues moving without moving the orb or box marker
Reduced motion starts still, cannot accidentally be overridden, and retains phase guidance
A live reduced-motion preference change stops visual motion without stopping text guidance

accessibleDescriptions.description: Keep the breath gentle, without taking bigger breaths to keep up. You do not need to fill or empty your lungs completely. Stop if you feel dizzy, short of breath or more distressed. Return to your normal breathing. This is not treatment and does not replace medical care.

Keep the breath gentle, without taking bigger breaths to keep up. You do not need to fill or empty your lungs completely. Stop if you feel dizzy, short of breath or more distressed. Return to your normal breathing. This is not treatment and does not replace medical care. Box breathing includes two holds. Do not strain or wait for the cue if you need to breathe. You can switch to no holds below.

limitations: Desktop Chromium, including narrow viewport emulation. No physical iPhone, Safari, VoiceOver or human usability acceptance.
Lifecycle checks include synthetic visibility/page transition events and an emulated delayed animation frame. Real device suspension still needs acceptance.
Research and traditional-context copy require independent review. Browser tests do not establish clinical efficacy, individual safety or religious authority.
Links are checked for local destinations and named external source addresses. This suite does not establish continuing remote source availability.
